notes.title: COMBAT
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222192/63350e4459e4fb515cf641803e64b389abd0fe98.png[/img]

We are entering the advanced production stage. We have a lot to show from Siege of Irdor. Starting today, every 3 weeks we will drop a new devlog about mechanics, story, gameplay, and this little precious thing that makes this game unique. Just keep in mind materials presented here come from early stage of production and can differ in the final game.

[h1]COMBAT SYSTEM[/h1]

As you have probably seen, Siege of Irdor is a Real-Time Strategy/City Builder/Tower Defence mix. You have to defend your kingdom - Irdord, but you can fight outside the walls if you think your army is strong enough.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222192/80eb5452e39de36080e7c915e9e8565d29592972.gif[/img]


Your units as enemies use 3 sorts of weapons.

Melee weapons. Swords, pikes, axes... fists, and more

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222192/2a5e94518bc9f541758d32c2662dd9d7adb52594.png[/img]

Every strategy fan must know the pleasure of using archers. We don't want to disappoint ranged weapons fans. You will be able to "shoot" a lot here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222192/015c2efec7ac2fc8b985157cc3ee4a2d62967678.gif[/img]

If you are looking for a "big boom" effect siege weaponry should be your first choice... and magic (but that we will cover a bit later).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222192/1130c7f586ac2b6f31dd6df427f81a6b59333186.gif[/img]

Siege of Irdor is a game where it's easy to start (casual and relaxing gameplay) and hard to master (good management and tactics). This strategy will contain a lot of "good strategy must-haves" 

Like FORMATIONS, but that will be covered in the next devlog. Stay tuned for more extra content.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222192/87497ccfc60d7f1344e5b0dd5a363f7e8348e951.png[/img]

The best place to talk about the game will be on the discord channel of our friends from Gaming Factory:

[url=https://discord.com/invite/a8Fw6mq][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222192/3275740acc70c627275e89ee73f2cec9575f4e27.png[/img][/url]

We look forward to your comments and feedback

HardCodeWay team

notes.title: Defenders of Irdor
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222192/ee16d353990afc4d49dc3d0d0445ea27569e39ae.png[/img]
[h3]Greetings Defenders![/h3]

Now, as we know, what terrors came from beyond Portal, it's time to meet brave warriors of the Irdor.

The entire industry of the City has one purpose - to keep those guys well fed and equipped, ready for the Night.

Every Irdor's unit has its counterpart in the Shadows army, but we ensured they had their strengths and weaknesses. 
Let us take an Archers:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222192/e894a122c43bb7f5ab3503c35a7e47953c9cfefa.png[/img]

He is better equipped than rag wearing archers of Shadows for the first sight, and they also have better range and more devastating shots. Human archers are pretty expensive to keep, though, and most of the time, you will find shadows outnumbering you by a lot.

Archers can be further upgraded while shadows don't seem to have high esteem for ranged combat (they prefer to flood the enemy with a backup of magic and arcane infused walking war machines like Taran).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222192/cf2773441dda2f1faae5df879f9f18a01febe922.png[/img]

We will discuss all those units separately in future Devlogs. 
Also, a little announcement:
[b] Future Devlogs will be written as a Shadows Point of View story of the first conquer. 
It will be not a part of the game as the in-game story is happening hundreds of years later, but it will be the part of the Lore and will give us a little insight into the enemy  :)[/b]

Meanwhile, stay awake, Defender, as Night is long...

Yours, "Siege of Irdor" HardCodeWay Team

notes.title: Devlog #8 Shades beyond the Wall
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222192/1347c248bfc65dedb5c8b890c9dbc24dccd8b538.png[/img]
Greetings Defenders!

It's been a while. Guess we owe you some goodies :)

[b]The army of darkness has grown of two new enemies.[/b]

The unstoppable force that will meet impenetrable defences of the Wall.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222192/de85e4827e9dd256524e5f123ec0383b62dffc0e.jpg[/img]

THE mightiest of all shadows. Pure rage packed into an ironclad of magic-infused heavy armour, basically a walking siege machine. Taran means the battering ram in Polish, and we believe this name fits him well. There is no unit in forces of humanity that could toe a toe with him.

The fragile but fearsome backbone of ranged troops in the army of darkness:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222192/dbbbb3a3dd76e34472fb45588f43061ead11ecb5.jpg[/img]

Equipped with light armour and a bow, Shadow Archers support frontlines with a constant barrage of arrows. Alone they are almost no threat, but the bow is a weapon you use in mass during the battle.

Thankfully when it comes to ranged troops, humanity stands superior.

"If you know the enemy and know yourself, you need not fear the result of a hundred battles. If you know yourself but not the enemy, for every victory gained you will also suffer a defeat. If you know neither the enemy nor yourself, you will succumb in every battle." 

Now, as we "know" the enemy, it's time to know ourselves In the next Devlog - Defenders of Irdor.
It should appear this week or next.

Meanwhile, stay awake, Defender, as night is long...

Yours, "Siege of Irdor" HardCodeWay Team

notes.title: Siege of Irdor
notes.notes:
Greetings Defenders!

We have a few important announcements.

[list]
[*]Big Battle: Defend the Wall new name is Siege of Irdor
[*]Our Steam Store page is now updated with a new art style
[*]The Publisher has changed to Vision Edge Entertainment. VEE are publishing another game of HardCodeWay "Dinos Reborn". We are very happy with the professionalism and results of the devteam. Therefore we have decided to extend our cooperation and publish another game of HardCodeWay.
[/list]
Let's recap what Siege of Irdor is all about.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222192/42ecd1aa028bb278e5c38ef5d2f3bbce90a1fbce.png[/img]

In 1038 a gateway appeared out of nowhere from which all sorts of nightmares started to crawl out. Vast numbers of determined and fearful warriors stood against the army of darkness. They fought and died in huge numbers. Humanity stopped the Evil but... never defeated. Now they are back.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222192/32228b106d1eae27efe1e92fd76e98bfa8befd37.jpg[/img]

We play as the commander of The Wall. It is a massive blockade combined with the town and villages built after the previous War to protect the lands of Irdor.

After years of threat remaining silent, the whole place deteriorated. Now it's our task to rebuild the area, stop Shadows and find a way to defeat them once for all.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222192/3f26cadfdd2e27d2c387ed6eaf57d512ddbe6ed1.png[/img]

Gameplay-wise the game combines several well-known mechanics and add some twists to the genre.

The game divides into two stages - Night & Day. The Day is when we are building our town and economy, recruiting and upgrading troops, gathering food and resources.

This part of the game is a city builder with inspired games like the Settlers, Spellforce 3 or Northgard. We are also veterans of city builders classics like Zeus, Pharaoh or Caesar ant this will leave a mark on the Siege of Irdor as well. We don't want to make it too sophisticated but it should be more complex than Your average RTS game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222192/242edc5a4f2e5da8ea69660e240e62852cc5725a.png[/img]
[i]Additionally, the game has seasons. Depending on the season, some of the resources are less available or straight unavailable.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222192/e65575194716a2c0cbfc43aff1ab3f90b708295c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222192/a97faaad7cc769d358240893b4117078c619d41c.gif[/img]

[h3]The Night is the time of War.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222192/83105ac97facb117ed5555a97825d0461c57f558.png[/img]

At Night the game is changing. During the Night, the game becomes a mix of classic RTS games with many tower defence mechanics. The Wall itself has a complex system of destruction that will sink our resources during the Day to repair breaches.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222192/8a3901c255e5e74e337469bbf9078deb742ca597.gif[/img]

Who are the Shadows? Why did they come to this world, and why they were inactive for such a long time. Will You be able to save the Kingdom of Irdor, or will You fall under powers of darkness?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222192/e0a16497feb2fcc5e82e66b02ebedbf812ac8d10.png[/img]

Currently, we are playtesting combat. SoI units come with various passives and skills, so there is a lot to balance. We are constantly improving graphics. The new trailer is basically ready, and we are just waiting for a cool event to publish it ;)

We would love to invite You to our brand new Vision Edge Entertainment Discord Server
[url=https://discord.gg/4VYutJ3G8E]https://discord.gg/4VYutJ3G8E[/url]

Meanwhile, stay awake, Defender, as Night is long.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222192/0da1f0e381ed1da8876a3b5d468f0e7f5a871e44.gif[/img]

Yours, "Big Battle: Defend the Wall" HardCodeWay Team

notes.title: Devlog #7 The Trade and The Village
notes.notes:
Greetings Defenders.

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1103820/announcements/detail/4545805013804487858]As said in the last Devlog [/url]we are not alone against Invasion. The game will be divided into two kinds of maps. The Town map and The World Map. We will talk about The World Map another time.

The first and main one is The Wall and the Town we are building nearby. Let's call it Town Map for now. It is the core of our game economy and the main battlefield. Here we are building, managing and fighting in RTS gameplay. We also will receive a variety of story quests and randomized side-quests here.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222192/acd77f924ca0eb8e71d0d00141f1a7dc353b926d.png[/img]
[i]Zug Zug intensifies.[/i]

This map is [b]BIG[/b]. It will contain The Portal area, No-mans land, The Wall, The Town, The Village, The Forest, The Sea or Lake (we need to decide, Big Lake with rivers is more tempting) and some more areas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222192/042b86810e20d815f8e5fc2cc72865eb61053cca.png[/img]
[i]Country rooooads....[/i]

Today we will talk about the Village. During the campaign, there will be a possibility to help rebuild the Village and establish Trade Route with them. They will send Trading Cart to our Town and allow us to trade with them from time to time. Trading will be manual and will allow us to exchange advanced Town made resources for much-needed food or wood from the Village.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222192/9f70888b35f1ca2ae43a1d6eea1a28e9a49e5c50.png[/img]
[i]Take me hooomeee...[/i]

Two prerequisites need to be achieved. The first is to complete the Rebuild the Village chain quest, and the second one is to build a marketplace:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222192/b885e4d28d7821c3d5f79d479af89915694b26b4.gif[/img]

The Marketplace will allow trading not only with the Village but also with other towns on World Map. 
World map will work similarly to the classics like Pharaoh, Zeus: Master of Olympus or Caesar series with some of our ideas and improvements. We will talk about it thoroughly in the future.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222192/5f001537e31902a9e1195fb47c6754fabcab9a83.png[/img]
"To the place I beloooong!"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222192/b7ee9d7df68f0007c74e4d35b1cfe5573c9eaf46.png[/img]
"West Irdor, mountain momma 
Take me home, country roads"

Meanwhile, stay awake, Defender, as night is long and those peasants above are so screwed.

Yours, "Big Battle: Defend the Wall" HardCodeWay Team

notes.title: Devlog #6 Shadow Commander
notes.notes:
Beware, Wall Defenders.

He is coming. The Shadow Commander
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222192/60face921555d7a175cceda3e62103e841ee30d1.jpg[/img]

Or instead, we should say THEY are coming as we will face several Shadow Commanders during the game.

They will have some core abilities in common, but they will differ every time you meet one of those. 
All of them will have heavy plate armour and sword. Some will bring Large Shields. 

When we manage to kill one of them, all enemy units receive statistics debuff. It creates a nice tactical choice on the battlefield and allows us to leverage the debuff effect for our benefit. Mind he will be always guarded by his bodyguards (unit not yet revealed)

Every commander will have his own combat skills.

Commander stats increase each time we met them.

And to not make it too easy we made them quite big. Not as Big as Alpha Shadows but still...
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222192/031399327b89f96d518502ea18c026dd2ec5614e.jpg[/img]
[i]All Shadow Units so far with their relative size.[/i]

notes.title: Devlog #4 - The Wall
notes.notes:
[h3]Greetings Defenders![/h3]

From now on we will prepare short videos for every Devlog with a showcase of our current work.
Without further ado, the video is below
[previewyoutube=0-0wrBzSof0;full][/previewyoutube]
In the video, we can see level two of The Wall. Like most buildings in the game, it will have three upgrades, but upgrading a wall is a task way more demanding than other buildings.

Like one might notice, The Wall is a tough nut to crack. Massive Gates, Towers and a Ditch. And it's not even its final form. 

As we were mentioned in previous Devlogs. The day is a time of Peace, and Night is a time of War.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222192/6de568749c0decf0762a07b52b498706b6970bda.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222192/a01eff1b12cb98e47b644edfcfa8539870f7b6fb.png[/img]
[i]With more towers ready.[/i]

We will set our archers on the walls and towers and various defence systems like boiling oil.

Additionally, we will be able to support our defences with Siege Machines. Preferably hidden behind the Wall, but we are not going to stop Winterfell Tacticians from their shenanigans. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222192/85e68595f22741e1977f90e7e268fd90821573eb.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222192/bab65c4aebd8d0b8dd71bee8ad276eefbae5eec0.png[/img]
[i]We don't have cavalry for the frontal attack, though...[/i]

Meanwhile, we were further expanding and improving our Food System that was [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1103820/view/3051728128610828390]briefly introduced here[/url].

[b]Food is CRUCIAL for our survival[/b]. Your soldiers and villagers need to eat, and if they don't, they will go insane and may leave You. To make food gathering spicier, we are introducing Seasons.

It is possible to store food inside Warehouse.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222192/9a510dd3c50c1e0a45f9461a08e8394750d8c987.png[/img]
[b][i]Snapshot from our Trailer that is coming next week![/i][/b]

[h3][b]Not all food sources will work in all Seasons![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222192/389f242d365117efd572b68e6241534ada312f11.png[/img]
[i]Farms are a great source of food. It's not working during Winter.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222192/265abb73035a8674b2c22429d28392099ffd4f7f.png[/img]
Hunters are not a stable source of food. It's hit or miss but works for all seasons.

We can have fishing boats as well that will not work in Winter, but the model is not ready yet :) It will be possible to trade other resources for food on Marketplace.

There will be various weather conditions as well. It's still yet to be decided how they will affect the gameplay. IF we choose to reduce Human units FOV during rain, those guys will certainly use it to their advantage.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222192/dc0dadb9975da0750c9dd39c876218bbfaac473e.png[/img]

From the military point of view. We are currently working on basic AI in the game. We are also implemented Barracks and Blacksmith.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222192/5712d4a7ffe81d9a4940d044feffed3bc72c33ee.png[/img]
[i]Good ol' Barracks. Allows for basic recruitment.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35222192/ae1d32cf0a5a55279bc063e33ef61424d665a758.png[/img]
[i]The blacksmith will improve our Fortress and Army in various ways.[/i]


Meanwhile, stay awake, Defender, as night is long...
Yours, "Big Battle: Defend the Wall" HardCodeWay Team

notes.title: miniDevlog #2 - Food
notes.notes:
[h3]Greetings Defenders![/h3]

Subject for today: Food gathering buildings:

There will be a total of five basic resources in the game:
[list]
[*]stone, 
[*]wood, 
[*]iron, 
[*]food, 
[*]gold
[/list]
Additionally, there will be one special "resource" that will use all of the above. There will be a resource amount limit expandable by Warehouse building.

Today we will share the two food gathering buildings crucial for maintaining the Wall. Food will be mostly used for recruitment. [b]If we fail to hold enough food people will leave our settlement.[/b]

Note, almost every single building in the game can be upgraded up to the third level. 

There will be a forest nearby our main base. Hunters every morning will go there to gather food. We see hunting as a not a stable source of food. There will be chance that hunters bring nothing from their expedition. When they succeed they can bring a lot of food. Overall farming is a more stable source.

notes.title: Devlog #2 - Shadows of Irdor
notes.notes:
[h3]Greetings Defenders![/h3]

Today we will share what lurks in the night and wait for You to make a mistake.

Despise the long War, we don't know much about them aside from two things. They came from the portal, and they want us dead. We call them...
[h3]Shadows[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/JtsnD8V.png[/img]
[i]Shadows Light Infantry Concept Art. Still looking for a cool name for them :)[/i]

A basic melee Shadow unit. Fast, aggressive, [b]able to climb walls[/b]. Individually, it is not a big threat for a human warrior, but in a swarm, they can pose a threat to any defence.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/VK3qi3A.png[/img]
[i]Model ready might change until full release, but we like it so far. What do You think, Defenders?[/i]

In Big Battle: Defend the Wall we will have Day and Night Cycle that will affect gameflow. During the Day, we will build, repair, prepare and send troops to do various missions in the vicinity of the Wall. We will share how it will look like in one of the future Devlogs.
Workers are awake, and they can gather resources, construct and work in the buildings.
[b]
At night workers are going to sleep. The night is a time of War.[/b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/c45fVJ6.png[/img]

A powerful unit that inspires nearby units to fight and terrifies nearby enemies. Due to its size, Alpha can knock down several opponents with one blow. It is also heavily armoured and hard to beat.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YtsOfs2.png[/img]

He will be twice the size of the Light Infantry unit, very hard to take down without the support of archery and/or mages due to the armour. Because of its ferocity, it will buff the statistics of nearby Shadows and debuff human troops.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/iFmwqw9.png[/img]
[i]Low-poly is awesome for creating RTS units.[/i]

Right now, we are planning to create around 8-10 types of units both for humans and shadows.
[b]All of those units will be upgradeable[/b], but we are still brainstorming and testing various solutions.
 We will talk more about it in future Devlogs.

Years ago, mages from the entire kingdom tried to close the portal, and they failed. For centuries it remains open, but Shadows didn't come. Nobody who entered it came back.
Maybe History will remember You as a Hero who found the way to shut it for eternity? Or possibly there won't be anybody to remember.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/LeRu7kF.png[/img]

[h3]What we are working on right now?[/h3]
We are preparing models for both sides of a conflict that we will keep sharing in future Devlogs. Simultaneously we are working on game mechanics, story and concept arts. Since The Settlers and various City Builders are an inspiration for the economy in our game, we are working on the economic aspects of the game.

Steam page update is coming soon as well, as it is really outdated now.

Meanwhile, stay awake, Defender, as night is long...
Yours, "Big Battle: Defend the Wall" HardCodeWay Team

notes.title: Devlog #1 - Hello, we are HardCodeWay
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Publisher note:[/b][/h3]
We regret to inform you that Forestlight Games Studio is no longer producing the game. After several iterations of the early version of the game, we made a joint decision to discontinue further development together for various reasons.

However, where the bad news ends, good news begins. 
[olist]
[*] [b]HardCodeWay[/b] is now developer of title. The studio gathered many talented people and funnelled their creativity into Big Battle: Defend the Wall game. We believe we will be able to deliver a memorable and fun RTS game together. Fingers crossed :)

[*] [b]Big Battle: Defend the Wall[/b] will receive regular updates about its development progress from now. We encourage You to become a part of development as we are always open to ideas and feedback. Add us to Your wishlist to stay tuned with the news.
[/olist]Now we leave The Wall for HardCodeWay to share their vision of a game.
Yours, [i]Gaming Factory S.A. Team[/i]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Au3o1Sz.png[/img]

[h3]Greetings Defenders![/h3]

We are happy to announce that from today we will publish Devlogs about game development every three weeks to keep You informed about progress and allow us to receive early feedback from the community.

So without further ado, lets dive into the [b]Kingdom of Irdor[/b] whose defence will be your duty.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/kWhsGuK.png[/img]

Today we would like to share some facts about the game for a better picture of what kind of game it's going to be and what we will talk about in future Devlogs.

Our goal is to create a fun, outstanding and challenging RTS game in a Dark Fantasy setting with a defence of the Wall as the main theme with a pinch of City Builder game. 

[h3]When designing the game, we decided to take some generic gameplay solutions and graphic style and experiment the hell with them.[/h3]

We will share the fruits of this idea with You soon. For now, let us introduce You to overall game aesthetics. You might notice a combination of low-poly graphics with deep, dark shadows and quite gloomy colours. This will allow us to maintain the sense of insecurity and danger that constantly hangs over an otherwise beautiful kingdom. What is the threat to our kingdom? Its a secret for future Devlogs ;)
[img]https://i.imgur.com/jsv4EM6.png[/img][i]Resource gathering will happen in a very classic RTS style. Tactics and Combat are our main focus.[/i]

[h3]What we are working on right now?[/h3]
We are preparing models for both sides of a conflict that we will share with You in our next Devlog. Simultaneously we are working on game mechanics, story and concept arts. There will be a lot of physics involved as well, so enemy destroying Your precious Big Building will be twice as heartbreaking when crumbling in style, especially at night :)

Steam page update is coming soon as well as it is really outdated now.

Meanwhile, stay awake, Defender, as night is long...
Yours, "Big Battle: Defend the Wall" Team
